response.overview: On Sunday, December 13, 2026, at 5 PM, APC CATCH invites you to Studio Jenny in Nanterre for one final show to end the year in style!  NATE PRINCE, the new APC Champion, and RHIO, the new APC Women's Champion, will both be there to kick off a new chapter in their reigns.  Joining them is a very special guest: NICK WAYNE! The AEW star is coming to Nanterre!  A unique opportunity to see him up close and personal, right by the ring, in the incredible atmosphere of Studio Jenny.  Who will end the year with a bang at DOOMSDAY?
response.title: APC Doomsday
